From Country Living Magazine: Portland Japanese Garden Among 5 Gardens Worth Planning Vacation Around

Posted by Portland Japanese Garden on August 7, 2026

Share this

  • Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook
  • Share on X (Opens in new window) X
  • Email a link to a friend (Opens in new window) Email

0:00 / 0:45
Instaread

In a recent article in Country Living Magazine, Portland Japanese Garden was named among five U.S. gardens “worth planning a vacation around.” Charlyne Mattox, author of the piece, writes, “Frequently ranked among the world’s finest Japanese gardens outside Japan, this 12.5-acre sanctuary is designed to inspire a sense of peace and reflection.” To read the rest of what Mattox had to say about the Garden and to learn the fantastic company it keeps in this short list, read the article on Country Living’s website.
